Name: Unofficial Starblue Blue Grass Xiddav's Tilesheet 1.6.7 Fix
Author: runangiejar
Description:
[b]A super tiny mod that only fixes a spring tilesheet to include Starblue’s signature blue grass. Of course, it requires the stunning tiles from Xiddav’s Tilesheet by xiddav, along with the amazing Starblue recolor by Lita (strangelyliteral) and CherrySymphony.[/b]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085?tab=files]Starblue Valley Unofficial for 1.6[/url]: Lita: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/strangelyliteral]strangelyliteral[/url]﻿, [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CherrySymphony?gameId=1303]CherrySymphony[/url]
